editorial:
Imagine getting a call that your sister died suddenly, and you just know something is wrong. That is exactly what happens to Jamie, a driven reporter who heads to Singapore to find out why her sister really passed away. You will quickly see that this is not a normal death. Jamie finds out that a scary demon is behind a string of kills, and the twist is that this ancient evil is using modern technology to hunt people down. It is a wild mix of old-school ghost stories and new-age tech that keeps you guessing about what is actually happening.

The acting is solid, and the way the movie builds tension is great. You might find some of the jumpscares a bit predictable, but the mystery keeps the pace moving fast. If you love movies where a smart lead character solves a puzzle while running for their life, you will enjoy this one. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that the demon needs a human host to stay in our world. Jamie and her brother-in-law fight to stop the entity from completing its ritual. They eventually figure out how to trap the demon using the same technology it tried to use against them. After a tense final battle, they manage to seal the evil away, finally bringing peace to Jamie's sister and stopping the killing spree for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and tech-based horror.
